answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and books one departure slot in one harbor tide window, filing a quill-signed voyage manifest listing cargo weight. An auditor checks key, scale log, and registry: mismatch, wrong key, or double booking in one tide window burns the bond. The fake pays 70 locked plus 30 fee. The k-th from one source pays 30+7(k-1), so the 1000th pays 7023 and 1000 fakes pay 3,526,500 plus 70,000 locked. An honest agent books one voyage, pays 30 once, and recovers it. A rented quill manifest fails because one key cannot cover two voyages in one tide window, so both burn.
